banner.title: Mahalo mākou i kāu pilikino
banner.text: Hoʻohana mākou i nā kuki a me nā ʻenehana like. Hoʻokō nā kuki pono i ka pūnaewele. Me kāu ʻae ʻana, hoʻohana pū mākou i nā kuki koho no nā hiʻona, ka loiloi a me ke kūʻai aku. Hiki iā ʻoe ke ʻae i nā mea a pau, hōʻole i nā mea a pau, a koho paha ma kēlā mea kēia mea, a hoʻololi i kou manaʻo i kēlā me kēia manawa.
banner.acceptAll: ʻAe i nā mea a pau
banner.rejectAll: Hōʻole i nā mea a pau

preferences.title: Nā koho kuki
preferences.text: E koho i nā ʻāpana koho āu e ʻae ai. ʻAʻole hiki ke hoʻopau i nā kuki pono no ka mea ʻaʻole hana ka pūnaewele inā ʻaʻohe.
preferences.acceptAll: ʻAe i nā mea a pau
preferences.rejectAll: Hōʻole i nā mea a pau

necessary.title: Pono
necessary.description: Pono no nā hana kumu e like me ka palekana, ka hoʻokaʻawale ʻana i ka ukana a me ka hoʻomanaʻo i kēia koho ʻae.

functional.title: Hana
functional.description: Hoʻomanaʻo i nā koho e like me ka ʻōlelo a i ʻole ka ʻāina a hoʻā i nā hiʻona i hoʻokomo ʻia.

analytics.title: Loiloi
analytics.description: Kōkua iā mākou e hoʻomaopopo i ka hoʻohana ʻia ʻana o ka pūnaewele i hiki iā mākou ke hoʻomaikaʻi.

marketing.title: Kūʻai aku
marketing.description: Hoʻohana ʻia e ana a hoʻopilikino i ka hoʻolaha ma nā pūnaewele like ʻole.

blockedContent: Ua pāpā ʻia kēia maʻiʻo a hiki i kou ʻae ʻana i ka ʻāpana "{category}".
